representations.name: Base-retaining Macaulay increment word
representations.new_information: Represents the exact G++ quantity as U_3(p+e)-U_3(p)-U_2(alpha)-1 and retains the base word of p together with every carry crossed by the increment e.
representations.first_test: Replay the audited cubic-gap counterexample and compare the exact cross-term against p-free bounds; reject any representation that again collapses to U_3(e).

representations.name: Coupled cap-complement pair
representations.new_information: Stores p and p+e by their distances to the same next cubic cap, so large base-dependent gains and carry discontinuities are explicit.
representations.first_test: At target-wall endpoints, test monotonicity of the two complement coordinates under one compatible r-step and kill it at the first reversed order.

representations.name: Signed full-word orbit
representations.new_information: Keeps the complete Macaulay word on both sides of zero at every row and defines the next actual diagonal surplus from the original orbit rather than a partial nonnegative-tail chart.
representations.first_test: Construct nearest actual rows around P=0 and V=0 and verify that the signed normalization agrees with direct full-orbit evaluation.

representations.name: Two-row deficit recovery vector
representations.new_information: Tracks (-gamma5)_+, distances of P and V from zero, and the exact gamma6 gain, separating applicability of rank six from its positivity.
representations.first_test: Evaluate componentwise monotonicity on every known gamma5-negative fibre and search for a row where deficit grows or a borrow wall is reached first.

representations.name: Residue-exact dyadic phase space
representations.new_information: Eliminates q with the dyadic equation while retaining divisibility classes and scales k/sqrt(h), r/kq, so asymptotic limits cannot use nonactual real points.
representations.first_test: For each proposed limiting bad phase, solve the exact congruence and produce an infinite actual subsequence or discard the phase.

representations.name: Moving-wall blow-up coordinates
representations.new_information: Centers at gamma4=0, gamma5=0, P=0 and V=0 walls using the compatible-r lattice step, retaining relative wall order as h and k co-grow.
representations.first_test: Compute exact wall separations in fixed-k, k~h^(1/4), k~sqrt(h), and boundary regimes; kill any claimed uniform ordering on one actual reversed pair.

representations.name: Canonical order-cell polynomial system
representations.new_information: On each realized ordering of canonical indices, converts gamma5, P, V and gamma6 into exact binomial polynomials with all chamber inequalities attached.
representations.first_test: Ask an exact symbolic solver for a rational or integer feasible point with gamma5<0 and either a borrow or gamma6<0 before attempting positivity certificates.

representations.name: Discrete finite-difference certificate
representations.new_information: Represents chamber polynomials in a binomial basis based at their wall minima, where nonnegative forward differences can certify an unbounded integer cone.
representations.first_test: Expand the known K=6,r=10 chamber and the G++ witness cell at their minimal legal parameters; reject if any required coefficient is negative without a compensating domain inequality.

representations.name: Actual-orbit coverage transition tree
representations.new_information: Starts from each actual dyadic low tail and branches on every literal canonical wall until it reaches a proved chamber or a named unresolved leaf; no relaxed state is admitted without an equality map.
representations.first_test: Replay complete strips j<=10 and demand that every enumerated row follows exactly one branch and preserves the direct surplus at each edge.

representations.name: Seed-to-suffix proof object
representations.new_information: Pairs an actual nonnegative low-tail witness with the exact localization into Gamma_r(M) and the inherited persistence hypotheses through M-42.
representations.first_test: Instantiate the certificate for the smallest states recovering at ranks 4,5,6 and reject if any index shift or legality inequality fails.
